title: Copper Networks and Generators: Retexture + Rus
description: A tiny resource pack for the Copper Networks and Copper Generators mods, reworking all the block textures and adding a Russian localization. Why not?
body:
A tiny resource pack for the [Copper Networks](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-networks) and [Copper Generators](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-generators) mods, reworking all the block textures and adding a Russian localization. Why not?


Это маленький ресурспак для модов [Copper Networks](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-networks) и [Copper Generators](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-generators), перерабатывающий все текстуры блоков и добавляющий русскую локализацию. Почему бы собственно и нет?
